title: Montreal Q NDE 2597
content: I collapsed due to a potential drug overdose experiment with Librium which became overpowering. After I dropped a glass ashtray that broke a sharp piece cut into my heel. I was bleeding profusely from my heel and passed out. Now here is what I experience next: I traveled out of my body and became conscious again. I could not see my body or where I was, except I was moving fast. It was very black, then a light appeared which seemed to be down/up/or along a tunnel. Next thing I felt higher than I have ever been in life, I felt a deep state of tranquility, love. MOST MOVING PART IS NEXT: Suddenly my recently deceased father (nine months before) appeared and told me it's not my time and I have to go back. I tried to resist but all of a sudden, I could see my mother working on me, trying to revive me and bandage my foot. I was looking down on my mother and my lifeless body. I felt very sad for her and then struggled to get back into my body and then I came to in my body, very groggy but conscious. I tried to tell my mother what happened but she did not think much of it and she called an ambulance that came and took me to the hospital where they pumped my stomach - I lived. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: MAY 1972 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Potential drug overdose, sedatives. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Can't say. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Talking to my father. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes As per above. Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes As per above. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Euphoria Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes There is something after death? Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Emotional. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Always had sixth-sense. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? As per above. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes As per above. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Left a slightly happier sense about father's death. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I know what I know. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? My NDE was very personal to me, I was changed by it but I'm not sure how. Reality tries to diminish its importance.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Became conscious again outside the body; later felt sadness for mother and struggled to get back into the body.

environment.environment_other_detail: It was 'very black,' then a light appeared along/down/up a tunnel; later he felt 'higher than I have ever been in life' with tranquility and love.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He 'struggled to get back into my body' and then 'came to' in his body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Potential drug overdose experiment with Librium; collapsed, cut heel on broken ashtray and bled profusely; passed out; later stomach pumped at hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He perceived his mother working on him and bandaging his foot while he looked down on his mother and 'lifeless body.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with rapid movement in blackness, then tunnel/light, then encounter with deceased father who told him to return, then OBE viewing mother and body, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported a 'potential drug overdose experiment with Librium' plus injury/bleeding as the precipitating event; described the light as appearing 'down/up/or along a tunnel.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly my recently deceased father (nine months before) appeared and told me it's not my time and I have to go back.”
